title: 《经济学人》封面魔咒：黄仁勋变魔术师，AI热潮要凉？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We are going to get to the book, but before we do that, I want to talk a little bit about the markets because you're a trader at Lehman Brothers.
segments.zh: 我们先聊书，但在此之前，我想谈谈市场，因为你在雷曼兄弟做过交易员。

segments.en: Now, in addition to writing books, you have the Daily Market newsletter that you've been writing for close to 20 years.
segments.zh: 除了写书，你还写了近20年的每日市场通讯。

segments.en: At this point, which is like before people were doing these letters.
segments.zh: 那时候，人们还没开始写这类通讯。

segments.en: And you do it old school. You send a PDF, you're not like substacking this.
segments.zh: 而且你用老派方式，发PDF，不用Substack。

segments.en: Substack actually tried to get me to switch over and I said, look, I'm not paying you guys 10% to do this.
segments.zh: Substack曾想让我转过去，我说，我可不想付你们10%的费用。

segments.en: I mean, is the reason why? Because you have that direct relationship and you don't need a third party to take a cut.
segments.zh: 是因为你有直接关系，不需要第三方抽成吗？

segments.en: Yeah. So there's no incentive for you essentially right now.
segments.zh: 对，所以现在你基本没有动力去转。

segments.en: OK, we could get to the economics of that. We do want to start on markets.
segments.zh: 我们可以谈谈经济方面，但我们想从市场开始。

segments.en: I love this reference you have to the economist cover.
segments.zh: 我喜欢你提到《经济学人》封面。

segments.en: So Jensen Wong on the cover of the economist.
segments.zh: 所以《经济学人》封面是黄仁勋。

segments.en: You say, quote, the freaking economist literally has a cover with Jensen Wong as a magician.
segments.zh: 你说，天哪，《经济学人》居然把黄仁勋画成魔术师。

segments.en: Check please, that's a wrap. AI is doomed. Time to sell in video.
segments.zh: 结账吧，结束了。AI没戏了，该卖了。

segments.en: That's it. Put a quirk in it? Yeah, I mean, you guys all know magazine covers work, especially the economists.
segments.zh: 就这样。有点讽刺吧？是的，你们都知道杂志封面很灵，尤其是《经济学人》。

segments.en: Like the economists somehow manages to like top-tick and bottom-tick everything.
segments.zh: 《经济学人》好像总能精准踩到最高点和最低点。

segments.en: And it's just really the nature of the cover. He's a sorcerer.
segments.zh: 这就是封面的本质。他是个巫师。

segments.en: He's a magician on the cover. It's like the time person of the year.
segments.zh: 封面上的他是个魔术师。就像《时代》年度人物。
